content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Richland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent. Gather records of your project leadership roles; Richland's federal contractors and national laboratories frequently employ professionals ready to meet these benchmarks.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions from your Richland location on a schedule that fits your work calendar. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples and prepare you for the exam's knowledge domains in an interactive, collaborative format.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application completion to ensure your submission meets PMI's verification standards.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to reinforce core concepts. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. You'll demonstrate mastery of project-management processes, tools, and professional responsibility across all five performance domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, contributing to the profession, or advancing your expertise. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration. Continuous learning keeps your PMP active and competitive in your organization and your local job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
